stock.headline: Nvidia shares sit 9% below their October 6 peak after a $96.2B quarter
stock.subject: NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA)

facts.text: NVDA closed at $217.09 on October 19, 2026, up 1.38% from the $214.13 close on October 16.
The highest close in the May 1 - October 19, 2026 window was $239.24 on October 6, 2026; the October 19 close of $217.09 is 9.26% below it.

ai.headline: NASA's Astrobee robots are still flying solo inside the Space Station
ai.subject: NASA Astrobee free-flying robots (Honey, Queen, Bumble) aboard the ISS

facts.text: Astrobee is three free-flying robots named Honey, Queen and Bumble; each is a cube 12.5 inches wide.
Honey and Bumble launched April 17, 2019 on Northrop Grumman CRS-11; Queen launched July 25, 2019 on SpaceX CRS-18.
On April 7, 2022, Queen and Bumble operated independently in separate station modules for the first time.
Arkisys, Inc. of Los Alamitos, California, was awarded a reimbursable Space Act Agreement in Sept. 2025 to sustain and maintain the robotic platform aboard the ISS.
A NASA photo dated Oct. 13, 2026 shows a toaster-sized Astrobee 'autonomously maneuvering' inside the station's Kibo laboratory module.

On Feb. 4, 2025, an Astrobee fitted with gecko-like adhesive grippers demonstrated autonomous detection and capture of a 'capture cube', a technique that may be used to remove space debris and service satellites.

car.headline: 1,001 HP and 407 km/h: the Bugatti Veyron 16.4 that rewrote the supercar rulebook
car.subject: Bugatti Veyron 16.4 (incl. Grand Sport roadster)

facts.text: Bugatti lists the Veyron 16.4's power output as 736 kW (1 001 HP) at 6 000 rpm from a 7 993 cm3 engine, with max torque of 1 250 Nm.
facts.source: Bugatti official Veyron 16.4 page (archived copy, Wayback Machine)

facts.text: Bugatti lists the top speed as 407 km/h and acceleration 0-100 km/h in 2.5 sec, 0-200 km/h in 7.3 sec and 0-300 km/h in 16.7 sec.
facts.source: Bugatti official Veyron 16.4 page (archived copy, Wayback Machine)

facts.text: Base price of the Veyron 16.4 coupe and Grand Sport: EUR 1,225,000 (GBP 1,065,000; US$1,700,000).
facts.source: Wikipedia - Bugatti Veyron (citing Car and Driver, Nov 2005)

facts.text: The Grand Sport roadster was unveiled at the 2008 Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance, with production starting in Q2 2009.
The final Veyron, a Grand Sport Vitesse named 'La Finale', was number 450 and shown at the 2015 Geneva Motor Show.

dubai.headline: Dubai property hit a record AED 917 billion in 2025 - and 2026 project completions are up 52%
dubai.subject: Dubai real estate market (Dubai Land Department market totals)

facts.text: Dubai's real estate market recorded over 270,000 transactions worth AED 917 billion in 2025, up 20% year on year.
Real estate investments in 2025 exceeded AED 680 billion across 258.6 thousand deals, up 29% in value and 20% in number.
Investors reached around 193.1 thousand in 2025, up 24%, including 129.6 thousand new investors.
The Dubai Real Estate Sector Strategy 2033 seeks to raise transaction volume by 70% to reach AED 1 trillion (a target, not a result).

Per DLD officials, around 104 real estate projects worth more than Dh100 billion were completed in H1 2026, value up 52% year on year, adding more than 24,000 new units (up 36%). (A related WAM/Khaleej headline cites 'over Dh111 billion'; the article's own figure is used.)
facts.source: Khaleej Times (DLD officials at Rise Summit 2026)

sources.name: Dubai Media Office - Dubai's real estate market records new historic milestone
